faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 10P Td5 engine in the Land Rover Discovery 2. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can a 15P Td5 engine replace a 10P in my Discovery 2?
faqs.a: Sometimes, but not always directly. 10P and 15P engines differ in emissions equipment and engine management, so we check your engine number, VIN and ECU before recommending a compatible replacement.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 10P engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Td5 engine supply only for my mechanic?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages, restorers and private customers can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 2 10P engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as injectors, a loom or an ECU match, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

faqs.q: Do replacement 10P engines come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Td5 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 10P engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 10P Td5?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 2 decide the right route. Loom, injector, fuel pressure and sensor faults can often be repaired individually. If the cylinder head has cracked, the engine has overheated badly or wear is extensive, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 2 10P engine replacement is usually more practical.
paragraphs: A replacement Td5 relies on healthy supporting systems and correct electrical connections. Where relevant, we inspect the radiator, water pump, viscous fan, hoses, injector loom, ECU connector and turbo, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain your options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Td5 10P Engine Problems
engineProblems.description: Early Td5 engines often give clear warning signs, and acting quickly can prevent expensive damage.

cards.title: Injector Harness Oil Wicking
cards.description: Oil travelling along the injector harness can reach the ECU connector, causing misfires, limp mode and electrical faults if left unchecked. We inspect the harness, connectors and seals.

cards.title: Cracked Cylinder Head
cards.description: Persistent coolant loss, overheating or combustion gases in the coolant may indicate a cracked cylinder head, particularly on older, high-mileage engines. We pressure-test and inspect the cylinder head.

cards.title: Unit Injector Faults
cards.description: Rough idle, smoke, knocking or a misfire on one cylinder may be caused by a worn unit injector or leaking injector seals. We test the injectors and check seal condition.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Fuel Pressure Regulator Problems
cards.description: Poor starting, hesitation or power loss can come from a failing fuel pressure regulator, a weak fuel pump or a restricted fuel filter. We test fuel pressure and delivery.

cards.title: Boost and MAP Sensor Faults
cards.description: Lack of power, limp mode or boost-related fault codes may point to turbocharger wear, boost leaks or a faulty MAP sensor. We check boost, sensors and turbo condition.

cards.title: Coolant Leaks and Overheating
cards.description: A falling coolant level, steam or rising temperature may come from leaking hoses, a tired radiator, a failing water pump or the viscous fan. We pressure-test the cooling system for leaks.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 2 10P Engine: The Complete Td5 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 2 10P engine is the earlier version of the 2.5-litre five-cylinder Td5 turbodiesel, identified by its 10P engine number prefix. Robust but now ageing, it can suffer injector loom leaks, cracked cylinder heads, fuel pressure faults and turbo wear, leading owners to repair or replace it.

Later Discovery 2 Td5 engines carry a 15P prefix with revised emissions and engine management, so the two are not always directly interchangeable. We confirm the correct Td5 engine for your Discovery 2 by checking the engine number, VIN and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, a full rebuild or a Land Rover Discovery 2 10P engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
